text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory suffers an injury, so I rush her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh man… Really? I can't believe this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's looking pretty down. I wonder what I can say to comfort her.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: This is such a horrible turn of events!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Injuries are such a huge setback! But I can't give up! Even if I fall, I've gotta get back up!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trials exist to be overcome! I'm sure I'll recover quickly if I just get right back to training!
choice_data_list: You know we can't do that.
You know we can't do that.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trials exist to be overcome! I'm sure I'll recover quickly if I just get right back to training!
choice_data_list: You know we can't do that.
You know we can't do that.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Even after everything I just said?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: My dad told me he never missed a practice because of injuries when he was younger!
choice_data_list: If he ever hurt himself this bad, he would have rested.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Grrr… I'm in trouble, then…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I've got it! I'll sit tight in my room as a kind of mental training!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That's what I'm talking about! Let's make me the strongest there is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we start warming up with our sights set on a quick recovery.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Urk!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …Oh no. It hurts worse than before…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But that just makes me all the more determined! Let's try a different warm-up.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory's spirit might be willing, but her body can't keep up. In the end, we decide to have her rest.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'd say this is the perfect amount of pain to give training a bit of a challenge.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: As long as you believe in me, nothing is impossible!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory's strong sense of determination leads her to a smooth recovery.
